doc: Convective tendency of a latitude set of 1e-5 .. 10 degrees (both signs, inputs.lat_deg) for the tiny, zero, negative, NaN and infinite Hadley edges of inputs.hadley_deg: the divisor is max(1e-3, hadley) (an edge of 0, -5, -1e-3, 5e-4 or -inf is the floor 1e-3, so x = |lat| / 1e-3; an edge of 1.5e-3 .. 0.1 is used as is; NaN is the floor because Python max(1e-3, NaN) returns 1e-3, as Rust f64::max would; +inf gives x = 0 everywhere). The latitudes run through x = 0.01 .. 10000 so every gaussian and the smoothstep see the floor value, not only the equator. Output [i, j] is hadley[i], lat[j]. Float64 closed form: rtol 1e-12. NaN and infinities may appear in the inputs (a rotation period None is stored as NaN) and in the outputs: NaN equals NaN, an infinity equals the same infinity (sign included).
